candidates.description: Send a self-contained, interactive HTML report to the local Nandz app instead of dumping a long markdown response into chat. Use this skill whenever your reply would naturally produce a table with 3+ rows, a grouped list with headers, a comparison, a set of metrics, a timeline, a dependency map, or any audit/findings summary — even when the user didn't explicitly say 'report' or 'visualize'. Trigger on output shape, not on request wording.

Renders any structured answer (lists, tables, comparisons, audits, dependency maps, timelines, metrics, breakdowns, summaries) as an interactive HTML page in the local Nandz app instead of as long markdown in chat. Use this skill whenever the user asks to 'list', 'show all', 'compare', 'audit', 'summarize', 'break down', 'map out', 'inventory', 'review', 'analyze', or asks 'which/what are the…', 'how does X compare to Y', 'what's in…' — even when they don't say 'report' or 'visualize'. Also use it for findings reports after running tests, security scans, code reviews, dependency analysis, file inventories, API endpoint listings, commit histories, migration plans, or any answer that would otherwise be a markdown table with 3+ rows or a section list with headers. Prefer this skill over plain markdown for any answer with multiple grouped items — the page is the deliverable, not the chat.
